$doc: Presets: a theme's character per brand or sector. Only what differs from the base tokens is listed: the primary ramp (11 steps, from src/lib/theme-editor/ramp.ts so the curve matches Figma's), the sans font (a family loaded by src/lib/fonts.ts) and the radius roles. scripts/build-tokens.py turns these into [data-preset] blocks in tokens.css; src/lib/presets reads the same file for the Themes page and the contrast test.
